tools.name: lint
tools.description: Lint one SystemVerilog file: parse errors, lint rules and semantic diagnostics. Output lines are `path:line:col: severity: message` (1-based).

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

tools.name: lint_all
tools.description: Lint every file in the project filelists (lazyverilog.toml [design]). Can be slow on big projects.

tools.name: format_file
tools.description: Format a file with the project's lazyverilog.toml [format] rules. Give start_line/end_line (1-based, inclusive) to format only that range.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

preview.description: Return the diff without writing (default false)

tools.name: goto_definition
tools.description: Find where `symbol` (as written on `line` of `file`) is declared.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

occurrence.description: Which occurrence on the line, if the symbol appears more than once (default 1)

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: List every reference to `symbol` (on `line` of `file`) across the project.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

occurrence.description: Which occurrence on the line, if the symbol appears more than once (default 1)

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Show type/declaration info for `symbol` on `line` of `file`.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

occurrence.description: Which occurrence on the line, if the symbol appears more than once (default 1)

tools.name: rename_symbol
tools.description: Rename `symbol` (on `line` of `file`) to `new_name` across the project.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

occurrence.description: Which occurrence on the line, if the symbol appears more than once (default 1)

preview.description: Return the diff without writing (default false)

tools.name: document_symbols
tools.description: Outline of a file: modules, ports, signals, parameters, instances, functions... with line numbers.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

tools.name: workspace_symbols
tools.description: Search project-wide for modules, interfaces, packages, classes, ... whose name matches `query`.

tools.name: rtl_tree
tools.description: Module instance hierarchy rooted at the module in `file`: `instance: module  (path:line)`. reverse=true shows the parents that instantiate it instead.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

tools.name: code_actions
tools.description: List RTL code actions available at `line` of `file`: AutoInst (on an instantiation line), AutoArg (module header), AutoFunc, AutoFF (always_ff), AutoWire, add default case, ... Pass `symbol` to place the cursor on it (e.g. the module name of an instance). Run one with apply_code_action.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

tools.name: apply_code_action
tools.description: Run the code action named `title` (from code_actions, prefix match ok) at `line` of `file`.

file.description: SystemVerilog file path, absolute or relative to the workspace root

symbol.description: Symbol text as written on that line

preview.description: Return the diff without writing (default false)
